params.resolution: The readable script miscext2.script _misc_DoDamage already gives the exact order: damage -= target shield (full if building finished, /3 otherwise), then protection[weapon kind], then clamp to 1; fast cavalry gets -5 for arrow/bullet. The native exe is packed, so the script evidence is the authoritative readable source.

The original skirmish AI lives in compiled .aix files (progreseconomicai.inc, progresswarai.inc) that are packed/binary and not readable here. The port uses an approximation that gathers, builds mines/barracks/stable, trains peasants and military, defends and attacks in waves; exact build order and attack timing remain estimated.

Original unit/building models are stored as proprietary binary mesh data (.actor/.osm under data/actors, 5220 files) with no readable mesh converter available here. The port keeps clean markers/shapes carrying the original portraits and icons in the UI, as documented in CREDITS.md.
